subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should Control UI resolve this issue with offset-based older-message pagination, or is a larger fixed initial history window acceptable for now?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the cap and the backend offset contract, but the right UX/performance tradeoff is a product decision rather than a mechanical code fix.

options.title: Require offset pagination
options.body: Use the existing chat.history offset response to load older pages on demand while keeping startup payloads bounded.

options.title: Accept fixed 500-message window
options.body: Allow the linked PR to proceed after real WebChat proof if maintainers prefer a small mitigation over pagination right now.

options.title: Fold into older canonical pagination work
options.body: Treat the broader WebChat scrollback issue as the canonical product track and close this only after that path lands or explicitly supersedes the linked PR.

recommendation.title: Require offset pagination
recommendation.body: Use the existing chat.history offset response to load older pages on demand while keeping startup payloads bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a Control UI history UX and payload-budget decision, and steipete has the strongest adjacent Gateway/WebChat history provenance in the inspected history.
